deal.dialogue: A coin for your trouble. It's warm. It remembers where it was minted, and it will want to go home through your ribs.

A formality. Sign here and the road gets easy. Think of me as insurance. You'll never need the claim.
I've seen the road ahead, and frankly it was too comfortable. Let me move some furniture. You'll thank me. Eventually.
I've seen the road ahead, and frankly it was too comfortable. Let me move some furniture. You'll thank me. Eventually.
Sharper teeth, thinner skin. Surely a fair swap. Nobody has ever complained, at least not for long.
Ahead there's a beast waiting for you. I can make it a hearth instead, for a modest donation of blood. Don't ask what's feeding the fire.
